Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog:
- Bone Align's Match facing now only turns you when it's confident, and otherwise keeps your current facing and just moves you into position.
- Fixed Match facing turning you 180 degrees on poses like doggy (hand to anus) and on kisses between two separate emotes.
- If an animation was remembered with the wrong facing, click Forget and align again.
